text:
alex_cs: FYI team 1/weekly health check for MercuryPay. Short summary: overall traffic steady, 5xx rate edged down 0.5% WoW but timeouts climbed +6% concentrated in nightly ingestion and large-embed jobs. Rate limit responses spiked briefly during a webhook replay. Posting top failing endpoints + windows and suggested triage.
rachel_sre: can you drop the top endpoints and the metric breakdown?
alex_cs: yep 1) POST /v1/ingest/batch-files  timeouts 1.8% (peak 03:30-04:15 UTC) 
2) POST /api/v1/embeddings/bulk  timeouts 2.7% / 4xx -> 429 on burst windows (peak 14:45-15:20 UTC)
3) POST /api/v1/generate/async  5xx 0.7% (mainly 502) correlated w/ retry storms from client-side lib v1.9.
4) POST /v1/chat/streaming  rate_limit 0.9% during 17:30-18:00 local peak (customer-region)
5) PUT /internal/sync/retry  5xx 0.5% and increased latency (spike after large file uploads)
sam_prod: noted that embeddings/bulk has bigger payloads after their SDK switched to batch-of-50 by default last week. That could explain the timeouts.
rachel_sre: added Grafana: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/mercurypay/errors?from=now-7d&to=now. traces: https://traces.redwood.ai/trace/mercurypay/1751234 (sample).
rachel_sre: quick repro curl for embeddings timeout (use --connect-timeout and --max-time to simulate):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/api/v1/embeddings/bulk \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
 -d '{"inputs": ["<long text>"], "model":"embed-1"}' --max-time 12
```
jess_pm: renewal touch in two weeks. Any material hit to SLA?
alex_cs: not yet at contractual SLA breach but customer has flagged intermittent failures in their weekly ops call. Risk = medium if we don't show improvements before renewal.
sam_prod: proposed mitigations: 1) gateway soft-throttle for bulk embed requests > 20 items (short-term), 2) client SDK patch to chunk batches (coord with DevEx), 3) schedule dedicated pool scale-up during 14:30-16:30 UTC for next 7 days (if metrics justify).
rachel_sre: will open a PR for the gateway throttle rule and add a canary rollout (assigning to @rachel_sre). I'll update when deployed.
incidents-bot: alert: MercuryPay embed timeout threshold exceeded (last 1h = 62, threshold=50).
alex_cs: action items: 
- rachel_sre: gateway throttle + canary PR (due: today EOD)
- sam_prod: coordinate SDK chunking guidance with DevEx (due: 48h)
- alex_cs: prepare renewal briefing + ops note for customer (due: before renewal meeting)
- incidents-bot: continue to post alerts to #incidents and page if new breach > 2x threshold
rachel_sre: quick check 1 initial canary reduced embed timeouts ~58% in staging sim. Will push to prod midnight UTC pending monitoring.
alex_cs: cheers 1 I'll draft customer note and share after prod change. ping me for any slide needs. :thumbsup:
